SPACE HEX TACTICS

Build up to 8 fleets and put them on teams (same team = allies). You command your own fleet; AI fleets fight on their own.
8 impulses per turn; spend energy and fire at any impulse. Velocity carries over until you burn to change it: burn 2 (reverse 4) for cruisers, half that for frigates/destroyers, one burn per impulse. To turn, pivot (cruisers 1 energy per 30°, small ships 0.5) and then burn; reverse burns every other impulse. Rotation per impulse: cruisers 60°, small ships 90° (Hunibler/Hunifer more, Dreadnought 30°). Shield generator at 25/50/75/100%; below 100% shields are capped at that share and can't be reinforced or repaired; if it goes off, shields collapse. Reinforcement and base-shield repair cost 1 energy per point (max 2 points/impulse; reinforcement lasts one turn, up to 2× shields). With "Weapon charging: over time", guns drain their load cost evenly while they reload. Hover a ship to see its weapons and outline; click the ⚑ faction button to pick a faction.
